summary.headline: Astrological Questions and Inceptions
summary.text: Catalog of astrological chapters 35–51, covering armies, lunar configurations, imprisonment, exile, infant exposure, judgments, lost objects, thieves, runaways, zodiacal elements, affliction, garments, agriculture, wells, interrogations, and Hephaestion’s universal inceptions, with cross-references to Hephaestion, Dorotheus, and Florentine and other codices.
